edit.description: Middle emphasis with positive guidance throughout; same M2 reward
edit.interpolation: smoothstep; phase is normalized over observed score nodes; no extrapolation
edit.normalization: dose is normalized over actual score nodes to a mean of one

failure_modes: Affinity: final predicted target affinity does not improve (or degrades) relative to the constant-dose incumbent despite verified dose delivery; coordinate control is secondary to affinity, so a coordinate-only gain would not justify the edit.
Strain/validity: generated structures show increased strain or reduced structural validity under the middle-peak schedule, reported separately from affinity.

Dose delivery: realized per-seed dose traces do not match the requested W2_middle_peak schedule (flow magnitude, gradient cancellation, caps, clash backtracking), so any quality difference cannot be attributed to the recipe; equal sum(dt*w) is only a ratio budget.
Path coverage: rare-path coverage or early compatible-path formation is lost under W2_middle_peak relative to the constant policy and the W3 time-order control.

Evidence scope: only landmark_00_local_dx was read; other landmark coordinates and soft_mass features are unqueried, so cross-feature consistency of the mid-window excursion is unobserved and could contradict the timing hypothesis.
Interpretation: the curve is a coordinate proxy in predicted endpoint world A with no energy or chemical-interaction meaning; no spatial force is derived from its time derivative.
rationale: H001 reports a time-varying contrast in landmark_00_local_dx over the full observed window [0.0,0.49]: a positive excursion in the early-to-middle portion followed by a negative excursion mid-to-late, with opposite endpoint rates (first_rate_z strongly negative, last_rate_z strongly positive). This is a non-monotone profile, so a uniform dose is not the natural match; the registered dose lane is the offered operative change and preserves the M2 scalar geometry (delta, teachers, mixture, temperatures, eta). Among the registered recipes, W2_middle_peak concentrates the ratio budget at the middle knot (dose 0.5/1.5/0.5), which aligns with the observed positive mid-window excursion while keeping positive guidance throughout, and it is the only offered recipe that emphasizes the middle rather than an endpoint. W1_early_soft and W3_early_strong_control are endpoint-weighted and form the time-order contrast pair; H002 explicitly warns that any fixed normalized-phase knot is a timing hypothesis, not a discovered stage boundary, so I do not claim the observed curve identifies a true stage. The choice is therefore a registered, testable dose hypothesis rather than a fitted optimum.
